metrics.against_the_theory: r2 and r2b both within .10 of r0 while r0 passes the fit gate
metrics.labelled: development read on N2 main states 4-23; one seed per rung; pi0.5 with frozen SigLIP and PaliGemma LLM, action expert trained, 6000 steps, batch 32, on 52,181 frames re-rendered from all 400 raw demos of K1-K8 (experiments/sc_rv.py). r0 whole instructions; r1 given role phrases switched by ProprioHeld; r2 r1 plus every movable object except the active role's filler painted magenta by its exact mask, fixtures never painted; r2b the same with bounding rectangles. Masks come from the simulator at test time (supervised stage). Read by experiments/sc_t34.py read --dir sc_t37 --rungs r0 r1 r2 r2b --primary r2:r0
metrics.mapping: Fit gate: r0 mean success on K1-K6 familiar under .80 -> UNDERFIT. Each difference: paired bootstrap over tasks and states (2000 draws, seed 0), new pairings N1-N6, familiar: STRUCTURE WINS iff CI lower > +.10; STRUCTURE LOSES iff CI upper < -.10; else NO CLEAR DIFFERENCE. Primary: r2 - r0. Also r2 - r1, r1 - r0, r2b - r2 with the same labels. Cost on K1-K6 familiar for r1, r2, r2b against r0: NO COST iff CI lower >= -.10; else COST
metrics.prediction: r0 near .45 on new pairings and at or above .90 on known. r1 - r0: NO CLEAR DIFFERENCE. r2 - r0: STRUCTURE WINS with r2 near .70, held at a little better than even. r2b - r2: NO CLEAR DIFFERENCE, r2b a few points higher. NO COST for r1; r2 and r2b lose under .10 on known
metrics.seen_before_registration: smoke rollouts on smoke states with an unrelated 500-step checkpoint to test the servers; contact sheets of the painted frames; a first painting rule (dataset rview) was built and dropped before any training. No rung of this ladder has been rolled out
